newsitem.title: UK: Ocean shares rise on news of offshore sale.
newsitem.headline: Ocean shares rise on news of offshore sale.

text.p: Shares in Ocean Group Plc rose 35-1/2p or nearly seven percent to a 12-month high of 545p by 0840 GMT, after the marine and environmental services group said it was selling its offshore support services business.

The agreed sale of the division to Tidewater Inc for 328 million stg in cash, will allow Ocean to concentrate on its core business of global logistics services in the offshore oil and gas market, the company said.
"The company had good results a couple of weeks ago so we've seen some good buying," one market maker said. "The disposal looks like a good deal and has brought out a few more buyers."
On March 6, Ocean reported a 16 percent full-year rise in pre-tax, pre-exceptional profits to 63 million stg from 54.2 million stg.
